title: The $r^\sharp$ invariant as a discriminant for the survival of the H-flux under T-duality on product manifolds
summary: We show that the cohomological invariant $r^\sharp$, introduced in [1] as a lower bound for the off-diagonal holonomy dimension of metric connections with totally skew torsion on product manifolds, predicts the behaviour of the torsion $3$-form under both dimensional reduction and Buscher T-duality.
